limits: One corpus: 15 merged pull requests found because they repeat one change, six files each, no test of any of the fifteen projects run.
The corpus was re-fetched from GitHub at the commits the record names and every file checked against its recorded SHA-256 before measurement.
Precision is agreement with the developers, not correctness.
The chosen pair is selected by running the shipped learner on the target files' before-text only; the oracle 'best' reads their after-text and is a ceiling.
'chosen' is not the pair that is right, only the pair that applies most; its precision is lower than an arbitrary pair's.
Refusals are the learner's; the five pull requests at zero are an algebra gap, not a selection failure.
The organ is the one in this tree; its hash is recorded. A later change to it needs this measurement re-run.
